notes: D1 oracle is the official MTR system map (routemap.pdf, Last-Modified 11 Sep 2024) HAND-TRANSCRIBED against the official EN homepage line lists and the corporate Railway Network termini page. Stations arrays are official EN names in official tick order. Not generated from GTFS. Not generated from the Transport Department all-modes zip (Transitland f-hong~kong~en / static.data.gov.hk/td/pt-headway-en/gtfs.zip). Not generated from Wikipedia. Not generated from the 2021 unversioned Next Train spec.
City id hong-kong only. Display Hong Kong. Agency MTR Corporation Limited. Do not invent city=hk, mtr, kowloon, or merge Light Rail / Airport Express into a second city. Not China as the country.

City stays planned. Modes v1: metro / urban heavy-rail only — eight lines ISL TWL KTL TKL TCL TML EAL SIL. OUT: AEL Airport Express (in v1.7 AND live on the same REST — that is the trap); DIS / DRL Disneyland Resort Line; Light Rail / NWNT (separate lrt/getSchedule + LR_routemap.pdf); High Speed Rail / 高鐵 (Hong Kong West Kowloon); Ngong Ping 360; MTR Buses; KMB / Citybus; ferries; trams; Peak Tram; mainland through-train.

Live feed exists but stays dark: MTR Next Train REST empty-key GET https://rt.data.gov.hk/v1/transport/mtr/getSchedule.php. Not wired. adapterReady false. envKeys none. No lib/providers/hong-kong.js. No dogfood harness. No public/city-catalogs/hong-kong.json. No GTFS trim/build. Skip D6 as a PR gate.

Locked inner-city printed name: Admiralty (spec ADM). Official + live REST: TWL × ISL × SIL × EAL. Not Central (CEN), not Tsim Sha Tsui (TST), not East Tsim Sha Tsui (ETS), not Hung Hom (HUH), not Kowloon AEL (KOW), not Hong Kong station AEL/TCL (HOK), not Hong Kong West Kowloon HSR, not Downtown. Tuen Ma, Kwun Tong, Tseung Kwan O, and Tung Chung do not serve Admiralty.
East Rail Lo Wu / Lok Ma Chau are EAL border stations — in v1, not HSR. LOHAS Park is the TKL branch — in v1. Racecourse is the official EAL race-day tick at Fo Tan (spec RAC) — in.
95 unique official EN stop strings. 114 line ticks (ISL 17 + TWL 16 + KTL 17 + TKL 8 + TCL 8 + TML 27 + EAL 16 + SIL 5). Interchanges counted once in unique names.
Direction: line + official terminus (Island + Chai Wan, Tseung Kwan O + Po Lam / LOHAS Park, East Rail + Lo Wu / Lok Ma Chau). Not compass, not inbound/outbound, never to City.

Next Train spec v1.7 three-letter codes are catalog siteId values, not D1 stop strings. No GTFS stopIds. Passenger line tokens are ISL / TWL / KTL / TKL / TCL / TML / EAL / SIL plus the official EN short names Island / Tsuen Wan / Kwun Tong / Tseung Kwan O / Tung Chung / Tuen Ma / East Rail / South Island.
coverageGaps: Airport Express (AEL) is in Next Train spec v1.7 and live on the same REST (AEL-HOK 200). Out of v1. That is the trap.
Disneyland Resort Line (DIS / DRL) is in spec v1.7. Out of v1. Sunny Bay stays as a Tung Chung stop.
Light Rail / NWNT uses a different official map (LR_routemap.pdf) and a different REST (lrt/getSchedule). Out of v1. Do not invent a Light Rail city id.
High Speed Rail / 高鐵 at Hong Kong West Kowloon prints on the mixed system-map plate. Not in Next Train v1.7. Out of v1.
Ngong Ping 360, MTR Buses, KMB / Citybus, ferries, trams, Peak Tram, mainland through-train. Out of v1.
Transport Department all-modes GTFS (Transitland f-hong~kong~en / static.data.gov.hk/td/pt-headway-en/gtfs.zip) is not an MTR-only subway feed. Do not generate this file from it.
Unversioned Next_Train_API_Spec.pdf is the 2021 plate (AEL/TCL/TML/TKL only). Disagrees with v1.7. Do not use.
